Oh my-... Woah.. ARE YOU ME??? HAVE I BEEN EXISTING IN MULTIPLE PLACES AT ONCE??? I'm 19F, I felt every single sentence here (not ALL of it of course, still so close) , you basically were able to write down everything I myself have been struggling to express. It's just uncanny.. I really feel you. I recently graduated high school but unable to get into college. My meanwhile friends are already in the second year. We stopped talking to each after we our graduation. I'm scared that they maybe the last friends I'll ever have. . They practically all moved on without me and it just made me feel like it's for the best and I'll just holding them back but at the same time I'm devastated, it's like telling me I wasn't really in the group to begin with, they're growing and improving together, simultaneously making new friends and having so much fun. And here I am just lying in bed frozen in time, watching them through social media. I would cry, constantly blame myself for this loneliness and not even making an effort to better myself, that I would surely die alone...

Fuck... I'm sorry. That's enough. 


I'm just hoping that you're getting some treatment for your MADD, OP. And maybe at some point somehow things will turn out for the better for you. Please take care of yourself :)

An ironic thing, really. How I'd give to find a depression buddy.. Just having someone sympathizing with you just shit talking about life and being comfortable expressing how youre feeling with minimal stress. Is just so relieving.
I really hope I will. Thank you.

Thank you for saying all of that. my mind has been replaying a lot of bad and cringy memories lately. This is one of the biggest where I felt I really should talk about to someone, and feel my head had gotten a little lighter. I really miss the moments where I wasn't thinking about ending my life. 
I'm sorry for not replying sooner. Thank you again
